verdict.headline: Protein claim on the listing does not match the declared label
verdict.summary: The listing advertises 30 g of protein per serving, but the nutrition panel works out to roughly 24 g for the same serving size. The category also carries an active regulatory advisory on unverified protein claims. No recall or contamination record was found for this brand.

findings.title: Advertised protein content exceeds the declared nutrition panel
findings.detail: Marketing copy states 30 g protein per 33 g scoop. The per-100g panel declares 72 g protein, which is about 24 g for that scoop. Claims regulations require advertised nutrient values to match the declared label.

citations.label: FSSAI Advertising and Claims Regulations, 2018 - Reg. 6
citations.excerpt: No person shall make a claim which is inconsistent with the information declared on the label.

findings.title: Contains a permitted but commonly flagged sweetener
findings.detail: The ingredient list includes sucralose (INS 955). It is permitted in this category, but products carrying it must declare it prominently. Listed here for transparency, not as a violation.

citations.label: FSSAI Food Product Standards and Food Additives Regulations, 2011
citations.excerpt: INS 955 Sucralose - permitted with maximum limits as specified.

flags.label: Advertised 30 g protein per serving; label implies about 24 g

grievance.reason: No CRITICAL or HIGH finding. A labelling complaint can still be filed manually.

disclaimer: Informational only, compiled from public regulator records. Not a laboratory result for the specific pack you are viewing. Always check the batch code printed on your package.
